root_idea.summary: A root orientation of lack of benefit and deprivation: an effort or undertaking yields no useful result and the desired outcome is withheld.
root_idea.development: The development runs from a non-producing fire-making draw to an undertaking that fails because it brings no benefit, and hence to disappointment, frustrated attainment, and loss.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Quran-attested Form I verb, displayed under its normal perfect-tense citation form.
Quran-attested active participle, normalized from the supplied plural occurrence to the singular dictionary citation form.

senses.definition: To fail to attain what one seeks; to be disappointed, frustrated, or deprived of the desired outcome.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of a person or undertaking whose sought-for goal is not attained; the result may be expressed as failure, disappointment, or deprivation.

senses.definition: One who is disappointed or unsuccessful in attaining what is sought.
senses.usage_conditions: Active participle of خَابَ; the Quranic occurrence is plural in form, خَائِبِينَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To disbelieve or become an unbeliever.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separately reported Classical Arabic use of the Form I verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone to fail to attain what he seeks; to disappoint, frustrate, refuse, or debar him from it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Causative Form II construction with the disappointed person expressed as object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Disappointment or failure to attain what is sought; in imprecatory expressions, a wish or declaration that disappointment befall someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Verbal noun of خَابَ; the imprecation may appear in accusative or nominative form according to the construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An unsuccessful fire-making draw or fire-drill—one that fails to produce fire.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as an epithet of a fire-making implement or endeavour that produces no fire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An epithet for one habitually unsuccessful.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the cited poetic expression it may be understood literally from خَيْبَةٌ or by comparison with a fire-making implement that produces no fire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Failure or loss as the result of an undertaking; an effort that ends in loss.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in the idiomatic expression سَعْيُهُ فِي خَيَّابِ بْنِ هَيَّابٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An arrow in the game of maysir to which no lot or portion is assigned.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical term for one of the three non-winning arrows in this game.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Futility, unreality, or a state of things devoid of useful result, in the expression وُقُوعٌ فِي وَادِي تُخُيِّبَ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression describes falling into what is vain or futile and consequently into disappointment; the variant تُخَيِّبَ is also reported.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Covers failure to attain a desired goal and the separately reported disbelief use.
Suffering loss is covered as deprivation and failed attainment.
Verbal noun and its imprecatory construction.
Two reported interpretations of the poetic epithet.
Idiomatic use for labour ending in loss.
Active participle of the Quran-attested Form I verb.
Conventional expression for futility and consequent disappointment.

cautions: The classical epithet خَيَّابٌ is reported with two interpretations: habitual unsuccessfulness or comparison to a fire-making implement that produces no fire.
The Quranic nominal occurrence is plural خَائِبِينَ; the displayed singular خَائِبٌ is the normalized active-participle citation form.
